senses.gloss: m.Augustus, title of the Roman emperor, in gen. ruler, sovereign.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:10">Y. Ber. IX, 12ᵈ</cite> bot. as one uses indiscriminately <he>בסיליוס קיסר א׳</he> (βασιλεύς) Basileus, Cæsar, Augustus; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8:9">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23:1">Ex. R. s. 23</cite>, beg.; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 12:10">Gen. R. s. 12</cite> <he>א׳ במדינה</he> ed. (Ar. <cite ref="A00237"><he>אגבאסטס</he></cite>) read <cite ref="A00264"><he>אַגְוִיסְטוֹר</he></cite> or <he>אַגְבָאִיסְטוֹר</he> v. <cite ref="A02098"><he>אנגיטוס</he></cite>.]
